ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single Unit (Detached House) District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-H in the area bounded by RS-3, Residential
Single Unit (Detached House)

West 63" Street, a line 78.54 feet west of and parallel to South Honore Street, the public alley
next south of and parallel to West 63" Street, then a line 104.72 feet west of and parallel to South
Honore Street,

to those of a B1-1, Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property:
1841 W. 63” Street, Chicago, IL 60636
